thread:
jen: FYI PR #490 needs small wording tweaks around retention vs consent in the audit export docs. Legal flagged ambiguity in the SDK snippets.

alex: dropping link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/490 — looks small.

maria: TL;DR the example uses `ttl` without saying it's tenant-scoped. Some customers read that as global.

legal-sam: please clarify: retention settings shown apply per-tenant unless the sample explicitly states a global config. Also, avoid the word 'permanent'  use 'indefinite retention subject to legal hold' for legal-hold explanations.

liam: ok I'll update samples. proposed tiny JS + Python snippets to include: 

```js
// Set a 90-day TTL for tenant 'acme' (tenant-scoped)
client.audit.setRetention({ tenantId: 'acme', ttlSeconds: 90 * 24 * 3600 });
// Note: TTL shown here applies to the tenant's collected logs.
```

```python
# Set a 90-day TTL for tenant 'acme' (tenant-scoped)
client.set_audit_retention(tenant_id='acme', ttl_seconds=90*24*3600)
# This applies only to the specified tenant's audit logs.
```

alex: add a one-line parenthetical after the snippet: "(Private/VPC deployments may follow customer-managed retention policies.)"

maria: or slightly clearer: "Tenant retention governs logs collected for that tenant; private or on-prem deployments may be subject to customer-managed retention and key policies."

legal-sam: also add the SOC2-friendly sentence for the compliance page: "Retention and redaction controls are configurable per-tenant; Redwood enforces default redaction rules and supports customer-managed keys for private deployments." Keep it short.

jen: we should also include an example CLI export that shows redaction flags so engineers see the default behavior. small snippet: 

```bash
# Export audits and redact IP and email fields
redwood audits export --tenant acme --since 2026-02-01 --redact ip,email
```

liam: I'll add `--redact` examples to the SDK too (JS: redact: ['ip','email'], Python: redact=['ip','email']).

alex: QA note: make sure the human-readable comment includes "90 days" while machine value stays seconds (readability).

liam: done. pushed changes to branch, including small wording per legal-sam. docs-bot shows update.

docs-bot: PR #490 updated by liam  https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/def456 

maria: I'll ping legal for final sign-off once CI passes. thanks for keeping examples compact.

legal-sam: quick vote: LGTM pending CI. If CI flags linkcheck, we'll fix anchors.

jen: plan: merge after legal sign-off + linkcheck. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
